responsibility: Audit and project selected refs from bare Git SSOT repositories to a replaceable remote forge using explicit compare-and-swap rules.

externalContracts.input: Manifest, exact source and remote ref identities, and explicit operator decisions
externalContracts.output: Audit, backup, candidate, restore, and promotion receipts
externalContracts.error: Non-zero exit without mutating an unclassified or raced ref
externalContracts.effect: Checked Git ref updates only in effect commands
externalContracts.compatibility: Manifest and receipt schemas remain versioned

internalContracts.boundary: Read-only audit and candidate classification precede every write-capable command.
invariants: Unknown or changed refs stop before write
Remote-only state is never silently deleted
